envelope.note: option B: single board tier; light plate 2.4 mm (2026-10-30, DFM)

SH1.what: split-ring electrostatic shield (rf2_shield_pcb.py): open rings + one radial spine, single-point ground

QA.what: SB1R-QA quadrupole receive board, copper unchanged; outline variant without the r 116 tab (does not fit a 2 mm wall)

QB.what: SB1R-QB (QA turned 45 deg), copper unchanged; same outline variant

stack_pins.what: 2 PETG pins from the skid through SH1 / QA / QB (the SB1R NPTH holes); the 22.5 deg hole carries the shield's ground wire up (SH1 plated pad there)

coil.what: rim mono, 6 rows x 5 columns (option B; was 5 x 6 at 1.6 mm), wound column by column down-and-up (owner's progressive order; about 195 V max between neighbours, 1000 V litz)

walls.note: radial sector walls 89 / 156 / 198 deg (themselves radial planes); the 156 deg wall keeps the LV slot for the HV1 output flex

FIN_HV1.what: MP1 v2 function: HV limiter (IXTY08N100D2), clamps, LMH6629 preamp; LV output by flex through the 156 deg wall

FIN_HV2.what: TXJ function: coil-lead and shaft TX-pair termination (wire-hole pads), damping network

FIN_A1.what: AB1 function: receive channels (mono, QA, QB, REF3), gates / integrators, ADC

FIN_A2.what: AB1 function: receive channels (mono, QA, QB, REF3), gates / integrators, ADC

FIN_A3.what: AB1 function: receive channels (mono, QA, QB, REF3), gates / integrators, ADC

FIN_D1.what: CB1D function: RP2354A, clocks, LMR36520 + TPS22918 LED rail, LED data, power entry

FIN_D2.what: CB1D function: RP2354A, clocks, LMR36520 + TPS22918 LED rail, LED data, power entry

FIN_D3.what: CB1D function: RP2354A, clocks, LMR36520 + TPS22918 LED rail, LED data, power entry

FIN_D4.what: CB1D function: RP2354A, clocks, LMR36520 + TPS22918 LED rail, LED data, power entry

FIN_D5.what: CB1D function: RP2354A, clocks, LMR36520 + TPS22918 LED rail, LED data, power entry

FIN_D6.what: CB1D function: RP2354A, clocks, LMR36520 + TPS22918 LED rail, LED data, power entry

FIN_D7.what: CB1D function: sensors, audio / link, spare

FIN_D8.what: CB1D function: sensors, audio / link, spare

HUB_PCB.what: LV hub: star (radial) interconnect of the LV fins by soldered flex tails; no ring traces (rule 5); 4 mm fill bore

LED.what: LED display: FLEX section of the rigid-flex panel (0.2 mm polyimide on a 0.2 mm FR4 stiffener), 522 SK9822-EC20 in 13 rings from r 104 to the centre (rf2_ledgrid.py), clocked, dark during receive windows and power-gated when silent

lid_light.material: opaque matt black PETG plate, one conical well over each of the 522 LEDs (rf2_lightplate.py: exit efficiency 0.97 against 0.41 for a straight bore, liner reflectance ASSUMED 0.90); wall liner = white diffuse non-metal paint (TiO2); a metallised liner is banned (rule 5: metal near the coil); well filled flush with clear resin (seals the plate)
lid_light.note: replaces the clear lid of option A

gland.what: shaft cable enters DOWN through the lid at the heel into the HV sector

potting.coil: syntactic foam (resin + glass bubbles, eps about 1.8 UNVERIFIED): lowest winding capacitance (rf2_zones: gate 15.96 us)
potting.hv: MG 832TC epoxy (48 kV breakdown at 3.2 mm; kept >= 3 mm from the winding: eps 3.7, DF 0.1)

ref_coil.place: on the shaft, 0.6 m from the head
ref_coil.former: 3 orthogonal windings, 100 mm, on a PETG frame
ref_coil.requirement: area-turns = 3 x the mono per axis (rf2_emi.py)
ref_coil.noise: 2.0 nV/rtHz, depth cost 1.4 %, copper 104 g (rf2_ref3.py; the earlier 620 x 0.15 mm on 80 mm gave 2.32 nV/rtHz and 1.8 %)

netlist_variant_note: rf2_netlist.BOARDS MP1 / TXJ 'head' positions are option A's; the option-B board builds take MP1 (-72, 3) and TXJ (-94.5, 0) (stage 4)

materials.coil_wire: Rubadue TXXL66/38F-2 triple-insulated FEP litz (owner 2026-10-30; DATASHEET_LOG RF2-DS-WIRE): 66 x AWG38, 1056 CM, finished OD 1.372 mm nominal, FEP 155 C / 1000 V (catalog rating), 50-100 kHz; 0.601 ohm over 18.3 m (rf2_wire_options). Breakdown and exact OD: request the vendor specification sheet
materials.sleeves: FEP on every wire in the head that leaves the coil's 1.37 mm litz: FEP-jacketed hookup wire for the shaft HV pair and the sense wires, FEP tubing over the litz lead pair to the TXJ board (same eps 2.1 and no creep; PTFE rejected: it creeps). Voltage rating of the finished wire is UNVERIFIED: must be >= 630 V (rule 6)
materials.coating: Parylene (SCS ParyFree, falling back to Parylene C) on the analog and near-coil fins: moisture and leakage barrier with no magnetic or eddy effect
materials.coil_potting: syntactic foam (K1 glass bubbles in silicone, eps about 1.75-1.9): coil capacitance 101 pF with FEP litz (rf2_qualify D)
materials.status: MODELED / sourced from supplier notes; not bench-tested

coil_combs.what: printed winding combs (resin print): radial plates with one slot per groove column (1.47 mm slots for the 1.37 mm litz, 0.30 mm teeth), the turns laid from the top, column by column

shield_coat.material: MG 841AR nickel coating, 25 um (1.6 ohm/sq): echo tau 1 ns (rf2_zones)
shield_coat.what: electrostatic screen on the shell's inner face, joined to SH1 at the stack-pin ground; one 2 mm slit

zone_rules: no solid copper planes; hatched 1.0 / 0.25 mm with every border slit (rf2_zones: closed border up to 3300 x noise)
no aluminium electrolytic or other metal-can parts in the head: MLCC only (can echo 2e4-7.5e4 x noise)
nothing switches in the receive window; analog / TXJ loops < 0.1 cm2, edge-on where the field is vertical
IXTY08N100D2 tab edge-on to the field or a tab-less package (tab echo 2700 x noise, tau 19.8 us)
every board is a radial fin (field-free orientation); fins located by rails and hub slots to < 1 deg
HV fins at 170 / 186 deg, >= 4 deg from the coil-lead path (178 deg); lead pair twisted / tight

hub.what: printed hub: radial slots for the LV fins' inner edges, a 4 mm bore to inject potting from the centre

fin_guides.what: paired floor rails either side of every fin (1.1 mm gap for a 1.0 mm board): tilt < 1 deg

bay_floor.what: printed floor over QB carrying the fin rails
